title: Teaching Ministry of the Spirit
definition: The teaching ministry of the Spirit is His work of helping believers understand, remember, receive, and apply the truth of God's Word.
summary: The Spirit opens hearts and minds to Scripture. He does not replace the Word but helps believers understand and obey it.
christFocus: The Spirit teaches believers by glorifying Christ and helping them see the truth of Christ in Scripture.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: The Spirit opens hearts and minds to Scripture. He does not replace the Word but helps believers understand and obey it.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers know God rightly, follow Christ faithfully, and avoid confusion in doctrine and daily life.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your worship, obedience, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
